milestones.title: Unity port of the browser game

tasks.title: Port every system and screen from the HTML game
tasks.detail: The full game runs in Unity with scenes, prefabs and data assets; parity audits passed.

tasks.title: Floating islands, Spirit Bridges, no offline progress
tasks.detail: Regions became floating Islands linked by one-way bridges (ADR 0002, 0003).

tasks.title: Real balance: 2-3 h first run, machines beat hands mid-game
tasks.detail: TEST mode off by default; playthrough bot checks the pacing (ADR 0004).

tasks.title: Island onboarding quests
tasks.detail: Quests that teach bridges, caravans and cross-island trade, with next-step hints.

tasks.title: Island requesters design (ADR 0007)
tasks.detail: Accepted 2026-10-12: 11 islands in a fixed order unlocked by tributes at the north Sky-Bridge Shrine; 11 NPCs (one per island) with 3 optional requests each; Heavenly Gate ending.

tasks.title: Phase 1: remove ascension, perks, vows, offerings; Heavenly Gate ending; save migration
tasks.detail: Old saves keep their progress; the game stays playable on 7 islands.
tasks.blockedBy: Starts after the art integration agent leaves the Unity editor

tasks.title: Phase 2: Sky-Bridge Shrine, fixed unlock order, Celestial moves north, Sky Paths
tasks.detail: Replaces the unlock steles; quests retargeted to the new order.

tasks.title: Phase 3: requester NPCs on the 7 existing islands (21 requests)
tasks.detail: Request panel, right-click feeding, rewards: new buildings and automation utilities.

tasks.title: Phase 4: 4 new islands (Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, Azure Beast Ravine, Tribulation Peak) + their NPCs
tasks.detail: Nodes, Azure Wolf, 9 buildings, 12 items, 4 NPCs; placeholder art until delivered.
tasks.blockedBy: After phase 3 and the Game.unity split (M5)

tasks.title: Phase 5: balance to a ~3 h ending
tasks.detail: Playthrough bot: greedy run 2:30-3:30, no-requests run under 4:15.

tasks.title: Art for the shrine, NPCs and 4 new islands (ART-SPEC §3.7, 144 files)
tasks.detail: P1 shrine + 7 NPC sprites first, then the new island tilesets, buildings and items.

tasks.title: South cliff walls, side faces, grass lips
tasks.detail: Islands show a 3-tile cliff on the south edge and a narrow earth face on the west/east edges, so they read as floating rock seen from above.
tasks.now: art loop: integrating deliveries as they arrive

tasks.title: Integrate vertical side walls (v2, with variants)
tasks.detail: Swap the rotated first version for the artist's corrected vertical side faces.

tasks.title: Integrate the new hanging undersides (3/4 rock, roots, vines)
tasks.detail: Replace the side-view rocks under the south cliffs with the redrawn 3/4 pieces.

tasks.title: Fishing ground patches (3rd version)
tasks.detail: Calm cool-grey shingle patches for the Fishing island; earlier two were rejected.
tasks.blockedBy: Integrated; nearly invisible in game; repair requested from the artist

tasks.title: Rebuild the sky with the kept background islands
tasks.detail: Background islands now load from their own folder so new deliveries can't replace them.

tasks.title: Cliff wall seam and stripe fix
tasks.detail: The artist's cliff tiles still have transparent seams and a light-to-dark stripe per tile; patched in code for now.
tasks.blockedBy: Waiting for the artist's corrected cliff walls (ART-SPEC delivery log)

tasks.title: Smooth stepped and long-straight coasts
tasks.detail: Diagonal coasts read as rows of short pillars; reshape the coastline so cliffs run in longer, natural stretches.
tasks.blockedBy: Picked 'Yes, now' (2026-10-12); waiting for the Unity editor to respond (Reload dialog)

tasks.title: All buildings, nodes, items and creatures have real art
tasks.detail: Every building, resource, item and enemy uses delivered pixel art.

tasks.title: UI chrome: panels, buttons, cards, bars, cursor
tasks.detail: The interface uses the delivered jade/lacquer frames, buttons and cursors.

tasks.title: Replace emoji icons in the UI with real icons
tasks.detail: Perk, upgrade, quest and toolbar icons were delivered but the UI still draws emoji.

tasks.title: Use the 10 delivered pieces that have no place yet
tasks.detail: Dragon stirring, meditating disciple, small glyphs, veil edge, waterfall pieces.

tasks.title: Windows and WebGL builds
tasks.detail: One-click builds; browser saves fixed so progress survives a reload.

tasks.title: Rebuild Windows + WebGL with the new island look
tasks.detail: Current builds predate the cliff walls and cloud sea.

tasks.title: Keep the scene file under GitHub's 100 MB limit
tasks.detail: Picked 'Yes, move it out' (2026-10-12): generated island layers become separate asset files in the repo (still on GitHub), so Game.unity shrinks well below the 100 MB limit.
tasks.blockedBy: Waiting for the Unity editor to respond (Reload dialog)
